subject.title: fix(browser): support GPT-5.6 Sol Pro effort

question: Should Oracle expose `pro` as a persistent CLI/config/MCP thinking-time value that fails closed for every target except selected GPT-5.6 Sol?
rationale: This is a new public configuration capability and a deliberate strictness policy for inherited mixed-model workflows, so implementation correctness alone cannot establish the intended permanent product contract.

options.title: Accept strict Pro contract
options.body: Keep `pro` available across CLI, config, and MCP and reject incompatible model or strategy combinations before browser acquisition.

options.title: Limit Pro to explicit CLI runs
options.body: Avoid a persistent config/MCP value and support Pro only when a user explicitly requests it for a GPT-5.6 Sol browser run.

options.title: Defer to inventory redesign
options.body: Pause this public surface until the broader model-inventory direction in https://github.com/steipete/oracle/pull/319 is resolved.

recommendation.title: Accept strict Pro contract
recommendation.body: Keep `pro` available across CLI, config, and MCP and reject incompatible model or strategy combinations before browser acquisition.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent GPT-5.6 release behavior, much of the browser-picker history, and the release-managed configuration and changelog direction.
